mines.mine_notes: Flagship development project, Wells, BC. Permitted and pre-construction. 2025 feasibility study (eff. April 10, 2025): 10-year mine life; 17.8 Mt ore @ 3.60 g/t Au; LOM gold recovered 1,917.5 koz; LOM AISC US$1,157/oz incl. royalties; initial capex C$880.8M; after-tax NPV5% C$943.5M, IRR 22.1%, payback 2.8 years (base case $2,400/oz Au, 0.75 C$/US$). Reserves Probable-only. FS economics per feasibility study; not yet in production.
mines.processing: Planned: underground mining with conventional gold processing

mines.processing: Test mining; ore shipped to third-party processing
